settings.title: Settings
settings.outputDir.hint: Used when a new queue item does not pick a folder.
settings.downloads.parallel.hint: How many downloads at once (1 to 4). Two is the default: beyond that the network and the CPU struggle.
settings.downloads.perHost.hint: How many downloads at once from the same site. Two keeps you from looking like a bot.
settings.general.pasteAnywhere.hint: Paste links anywhere in the window, not only in the box. Opt-in.
settings.general.notifyIdle: Notify me when the queue finishes
settings.jsRuntime.hint: QuickJS ships with the app. Deno is downloaded only if QuickJS fails and you allow it; the choice is remembered for 24 hours or until yt-dlp changes.
settings.youtubeClients.hint: Leave empty: yt-dlp uses its own client list, kept current by its maintainers. The original app forced "web_embedded,web,tv"; that list is now an option here, not the default.
settings.cookies.hint: Some videos need your session (age, private, members-only). Reading the browser database can fail while the browser runs: then close it, or use a cookies file.
settings.accounts.comingSoon: Configure proxy, custom headers and impersonation below.

wizard.title: Setup
wizard.welcome.body: A quick check of the tools and settings this app needs. Every step is optional, and you can change everything later in Settings.
wizard.welcome.hint: Nothing is downloaded without asking. yt-dlp and qjs are already inside the app.
wizard.tools.body: {count} tool(s) ready. You can change any of this later, in Settings → Tools.
wizard.tools.bundled: yt-dlp and qjs ship with the app and work with no network at all.
wizard.tools.ffmpeg: ffmpeg merges video and audio and converts files. The app can download and verify it for you.
wizard.tools.deno: Deno is optional: it is only needed when the built-in JavaScript interpreter is not enough.
wizard.transcription.body: Choose how transcripts should be made. Offline Whisper works without an account; Gemini needs an API key.
wizard.transcription.gemini: To use Gemini, add your API key later in Settings → Transcription. You can skip it now.
wizard.transcription.later: You can also download a model at any time from Settings → Transcription.
wizard.output.body: Downloads go to the system Downloads folder when it exists. Choose a different folder if you prefer.
wizard.output.hint: You can change it any time in Settings → General.
wizard.output.summary: {ready} of {total} tools ready. You can reopen this setup from Settings → Tools.

transcribe.title: Whisper transcription
transcription.gemini.keyInputPlaceholder: Paste your Google AI Studio Gemini API key…
transcription.gemini.modelHint: Dynamic model list from Google Generative Language API. Aliases ending in -latest are recommended.
transcription.gemini.keyStorageNote: Stored securely in your OS keyring (or permission 0600 file on Linux when keyring is unavailable). The GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable is also supported.
transcription.gemini.keyringFallbackNote: The OS keyring is unavailable. Your API key is stored in a private configuration file with mode 0600 permissions.
transcription.gemini.privacyNotice: Gemini transcription uploads a compressed copy of the audio track to Google's Gemini API. Do not transcribe private or confidential recordings.
settings.transcription.geminiSummaryPriv: Summarizing uses the Gemini API: it requires a Gemini API key and sends the transcript text to Google.
transcription.gemini.defaultSummarizeHin: Generates a structured markdown summary (<name>.summary.md) using Gemini map-reduce.
transcription.gemini.summaryLanguageHint: Target language for the generated summary (auto matches transcript language)
